setting: West Village street in the late 1990s just after a spring shower, soft warm afternoon daylight glowing on wet cobblestones, outside a small cream-and-blush-pink cafe with a striped awning, flower buckets and warm lit windows, yellow cabs

phrase.explain_vi: Lịch sự từ chối lời mời bây giờ nhưng ngầm hứa sẽ nhận vào dịp khác.
phrase.example_en: I'm busy tonight. Can I take a rain check?
phrase.example_vi: Tối nay mình bận. Hẹn bạn dịp khác nhé?

hook_vi: Từ chối crush kiểu sang chảnh 😏

shots.action: Viv shelters under a narrow cafe awning in pouring rain, arms crossed, no umbrella; Jamie walks up holding a big black umbrella and stops beside her.
Jamie under his umbrella, rain behind him, looks at her with a lopsided grin.

line.vi: Đang tán tỉnh tôi đấy à?

shots.action: Viv gives a sweet fake smile and turns to leave.
Viv steps proudly off the curb; a yellow cab drives through a puddle and drenches her head to toe; she freezes, mouth open.
shots.still_pose: Viv stands at the very edge of the curb about to step off, chin up, a yellow cab approaching through a big puddle behind her.

shots.action: Jamie calmly steps in and holds the umbrella over the soaked Viv, grinning.
shots.state: just drenched by a puddle splash: hair wet and slicked back, droplets sparkling on her face, coat darkened with water, makeup still perfect, still gorgeous

shots.action: Viv, dripping wet under his umbrella, glares, then a small smile breaks.
shots.state: just drenched by a puddle splash: hair wet and slicked back, droplets sparkling on her face, coat darkened with water, makeup still perfect, still gorgeous

twist: Her elegant brush-off is undone by a cab splash a second later; the 'rain check' arrives instantly.
cta_vi: Bạn sẽ nói gì nếu là Viv? Comment bằng tiếng Anh nhé 👇
